gates.detail: 1349 eligible nodes and 291 withdrawal events, reproducing spec db8c3a4f exactly. Q1 edges 11631, Q2 edges 11632. B(v) computed for all 1349 eligible nodes.
HIGH (B==1.0): n=131 events=20. LOW (B<1.0): n=1218 events=271. Each needs n>=100 and events>=15.
B(v) takes 103 distinct values (needs >= 10) and the larger stratum holds 90.3% of nodes (needs <= 95%).
HIGH stratum: product 0.4455 vs quadratic 0.4383, advantage +0.0072. LOW stratum: product 0.6159 vs quadratic 0.6180, advantage -0.0021. Difference-in-advantage = +0.0093 (needs >= +0.05).
90% bootstrap CI on the difference-in-advantage = [-0.0283, +0.0424], width 0.0707 (needs <= 0.20), from 2000 successful resamples of 2000.
with labels permuted the 90% CI is [-0.0348, +0.0364] and must contain 0. If a scarcity effect survives shuffling, it belongs to the strata rather than to the outcome.

UNTESTABLE-HERE. Of the five SDL substrates, yeast and GitHub commit no graph, the quantum arm is a derivation with no data, and PyPI's declared outcome (E_indegree) is derived from the SAME graph the scarcity metric would be computed on, which is circular. One substrate cannot establish a cross-substrate rule.
EXCLUDED. The analysed outcome is a continuous AUC difference, and DELTA = V*I*C cannot fail on a continuous unbanded outcome. A gate that cannot fail is not evidence, so it scores nothing.

D1_THE_BINDING_CONSEQUENCE.statement: K5 WAS MET, so K4 is interpretable at the stated precision.

D2_THE_GAP_AS_POSED_WAS_NOT_CLOSED.asked_for: a graph-topological scarcity metric across the five SDL substrates
D2_THE_GAP_AS_POSED_WAS_NOT_CLOSED.github: BLOCKED - a per-repository table, no graph exists in the repository
D2_THE_GAP_AS_POSED_WAS_NOT_CLOSED.interbank: the one clean test - metric from Q1 topology, outcome realised in Q2
D2_THE_GAP_AS_POSED_WAS_NOT_CLOSED.note: A single substrate cannot establish a cross-substrate scope rule, which is what SDL's DELTA was for. The SDL scope rule remains untested across substrates. Reporting this run as though it closed a five-substrate gap would be the error the spec was written to prevent.
D2_THE_GAP_AS_POSED_WAS_NOT_CLOSED.pypi: UNTESTABLE-HERE - CIRCULAR. Its declared outcome E_indegree is derived from the same graph the metric would be computed on.
D2_THE_GAP_AS_POSED_WAS_NOT_CLOSED.quantum: NOT APPLICABLE - a closed-form derivation, no dataset
D2_THE_GAP_AS_POSED_WAS_NOT_CLOSED.yeast: BLOCKED - interactome edges were never committed, only node-level rows

D3_the_metric_has_no_free_parameter.definition: B(v) = fraction of v's neighbours u such that N(v) and N(u) share no common member.
D3_the_metric_has_no_free_parameter.note: No threshold chosen, no weight fitted, no distribution assumed. The HIGH/LOW split is at B == 1.0, the natural boundary of the metric rather than a cut chosen from the outcome.

D4_the_rival_was_copied_not_rewritten.note: Both taken verbatim from interbank-2016/network.py so this run cannot advantage either form by re-specifying it. On the FULL eligible set the earlier run found them effectively tied at 0.6090 against 0.6109, with the rival marginally ahead.

D5_what_a_result_here_does_not_license.note: One substrate, one quarter, one country's interbank network. Nothing here is evidence that the domain limit holds on yeast, GitHub, PyPI or in the quantum derivation, and K7 records that.

D6_if_the_primary_failed.note: A miss means LISM's own declared domain limit does not hold where it is testable, and manuscript section 3.3c is an unsupported assertion rather than a demonstrated boundary. That is a null against our own manuscript and 3.3c is to be amended to say so.

D7_the_power_probe_saw_precision_but_not.and_the_caveat_it_does_not_remove: The HIGH stratum holds 131 nodes and 20 events. The PAIRED difference is precise because both forms are scored on identical labels; any SINGLE AUC in that stratum is not, and no single-AUC claim about it is made.
D7_the_power_probe_saw_precision_but_not.note: The pre-flight bootstrap was run on PERMUTED labels, giving a CI width of 0.0798 without revealing which way the real effect fell. The real labels were not used before the lock.

primary_verdict: THE DOMAIN LIMIT DID NOT HOLD ON THIS SUBSTRATE: difference-in-advantage +0.0093 against a required +0.05. Manuscript section 3.3c is an unsupported assertion where it is testable. K5 WAS MET, so K4 is interpretable at the stated precision. ONE SUBSTRATE OF FIVE; the SDL scope rule remains untested across substrates.
